attribute.reason: the cohort frame carries no attribute column: pairs are stratified by population/scope/difficulty/split, and the per-attribute axis is measured separately by training.attribute_separation
attribute.unknown_policy: a pair may carry several attribute slices, so membership (not partition) is the right multiplicity; a pair unobservable for every attribute is tagged 'unknown' rather than dropped

difficulty.unknown_policy: an unmeasured pair is retained as 'unknown'; easy/medium/hard are never invented

evaluation_scope.unknown_policy: a pair declares exactly one evaluation scope; a blank scope fails rather than being tagged 'unknown'

population.unknown_policy: a pair declares the population it was drawn from; a pair without one is rejected, never tagged 'unknown'

split.unknown_policy: a pair belongs to exactly one split; a pair spanned by two is tagged mixed, never 'unknown'
